text:
marie: Quick flag from research: onboarding modal looks broken for RTL locales (Arabic/Hebrew). Wrapping, back-to-front progress, and some icons point the wrong way. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.in/onboard-rtl.png devin: Oof. Are we setting dir on the onboarding container or relying on body-level CSS? If not set explicitly screen readers will read LTR order. aisha: We translate copy but forgot to mirror layout for RTL. Need `dir=\"rtl\"` on the modal root, mirrored SVGs, and to flip the progress pill alignment. Also button copy is longer in Arabic so we need flexible button width + aria-label for full text. ben: Accessibility notes: add `lang` on the modal (e.g., `
`) so AT picks correct voice. Use `aria-atomic=\"true\"` on the progress status so screen readers announce updates correctly as \"1 of 3 complete\" rather than mathy language. i18n-bot: Created ticket `I18N-472` for pluralization differences in Arabic. Reminder: plural rules differ (0/1/2/few/many/other). marie: UX question: should we switch the onboarding modal to an anchored rail for RTL locales? Research suggests motion direction and modal entrance feel jarring in RTL. Rail is less interruptive. devin: Technically we can conditionally use rail vs modal based on locale flag, but we need to ensure focus management is correct either way. If rail is used, don't auto-trap focus; if modal, trap focus and return on dismiss. aisha: For truncated labels, devs should set visible text short and full copy in `aria-label`. Example dev snippet: ```

انتهِ من الإعداد

الخطوة 1 من 3
``` ben: Contrast + typography: Arabic fonts tend to render bolder; check WCAG ratios after font change. Also increase line-height slightly to avoid diacritic collisions. Test on mobile where fonts scale differently. i18n-bot: Suggest adding telemetry properties: `locale`, `script_direction` (ltr|rtl), and `translation_id` so we can map copy regressions. Example events: `onboard_modal_shown { locale: \"ar\", script_direction: \"rtl\" }`, `onboard_action { action: \"finish|sample|dismiss\", locale: \"he\" }`. marie: Decision for this sprint: 1) add `lang` and `dir` attributes to onboarding container, 2) mirror SVGs/icons when `dir=\"rtl\"`, 3) add `aria-label` fallback for truncated buttons, 4) include `script_direction` and `locale` in telemetry events, 5) run an RTL QA pass (VoiceOver + NVDA + Android TalkBack). Devin/Aisha/Ben to own. devin: I'll add code changes and a small util to mirror svgs automatically when `dir=\"rtl\"`. Also will implement feature flag `onboard_i18n_rtl_v1` to gate rollout. aisha: I'll update translation docs with pluralization guidance and provide short/long copy pairs for buttons. ben: I'll run a11y checks and add visual test snapshots for Arabic/Hebrew, plus ensure progress announcements read as a fraction (\"1 of 3 complete\"). dev-bot: Feature flag `onboard_i18n_rtl_v1` created. Don't forget to add e2e tests for VoiceOver and NVDA in CI. marie: Thanks team. Timeline: PRs by EOD Thursday, RTL QA run Friday. Please add any small acceptance snippets to the PR for reviewers.
